text: dkitchen 是面向 DSH Web 的多岗位会话协作插件。它在 Harness 进程内注册工具，让你按岗位创建和管理会话，并用 GitHub issue 传递任务。还可启动后台长任务、查看输出、配置岗位模型与审批规则、监看仓库活动。适合在多个项目中编排设计、核查和执行会话；需要 DSH 提供相应会话、工具和后台任务服务，票务与监看功能需要 gh CLI。

dkitchen coordinates role-based sessions in DSH Web. It registers in-process tools to create sessions, hand off GitHub issues, run background jobs, and manage station configuration. Use it to coordinate design, verification, and execution. Ticket and watch features need the gh CLI.
想在 DSH 里按不同岗位创建协作会话
我需要一个面板式工具来查看和管理当前项目的 agent 会话
怎样把长时间运行的命令放到后台并在结束时收到通知？
希望通过 GitHub issue 把任务交给执行会话并跟踪状态
让不同岗位的新会话使用各自配置的模型
我想检查项目配置并修改其中一个设置项
How can I coordinate role-based agent sessions inside DSH?
I want background jobs to notify the session when they finish
岗位会话管理：按配置的岗位创建新会话、发送首条消息，并列出会话或查看会话看板状态。
后台长任务：提交命令在后台运行，读取缓冲日志、停止任务并查看本会话启动的运行记录。
GitHub 工单协作：向工单执行者转交消息、检查执行状态，并按已审查版本合并关联 PR。
仓库配置与岗位路由：检查或编辑 .dkitchen.toml，并为新岗位会话应用模型默认值。

**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

A DeepSeek Harness plugin that turns a repository into a kitchen: stations, tickets, long
jobs, and the bell that wakes a session when its job finishes.

dsh-dkitchen README · dsh-dkitchen：Installing the bundle is the whole installation. The tools are registered inside the harness
process through `ctx.tools`, so there is no package to install, no separate profile to boot, no
broker to start, and no MCP server to spawn. Nothing else needs running.

dsh-dkitchen README · dsh-dkitchen：> **Based on [917Dhj/dkitchen](https://github.com/917Dhj/dkitchen).** The kitchen itself — the
> stations, the ticket workflow, the house rules, and the bell that wakes a session — is the
> design of [917Dhj/dkitchen](https://github.com/917Dhj/dkitchen), and this plugin is its port
> to the DeepSeek Harness plugin runtime. See [Acknowledgements](#acknowledgements).

dsh-dkitchen README · Install：**From Discover.** In the harness, open **Plugins → Discover**, add this index

```text
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/songmingjun3/dsh-kitchen-plugin/main/docs/market/index.json
```

and install `dkitchen`. The index pins an exact commit of this repository, so what you get is
what a release names.

dsh-dkitchen README · Install：**From a release.** Download the source archive of a tag from
[Releases](https://github.com/songmingjun3/dsh-kitchen-plugin/releases), then point
**Plugins → install bundle** at the unpacked directory.

Either way the harness composes `cordis.patch.yml` into the profile and loads `index.js`.
Restart the harness if it does not pick the bundle up by itself. On first start the bundle also
installs the setup skill into the machine-wide skill root, so `/setup-dkitchen` works in every
project.

dsh-dkitchen README · Install：A bundle that fails to register a tool does so silently — the process keeps running and the
tool simply is not there. Set `debug: true` in `cordis.patch.yml` to have each registration
reported on stderr.

dsh-dkitchen README · What it gives a session：| Group | Tools |
| --- | --- |
| Sessions | `dkitchen_new_session`, `dkitchen_send`, `dkitchen_read`, `dkitchen_info`, `dkitchen_rename`, `dkitchen_list_sessions`, `dkitchen_board`, `dkitchen_session_status`, `dkitchen_archive` |
| Long jobs | `dkitchen_launch`, `dkitchen_logs`, `dkitchen_stop`, `dkitchen_run_status` |
| Tickets | `dkitchen_relay`, `dkitchen_merge`, `dkitchen_log`, `dkitchen_executor_status` |
| Watching | `dkitchen_watch`, `dkitchen_watch_state` |
| Configuration | `dkitchen_config`, `dkitchen_check_refs`, `dkitchen_status` |
dsh-dkitchen README · What it gives a session：The ticket tools need the `gh` CLI. Without it they say so and the rest keep working.

dsh-dkitchen README · How a repository configures its kitchen：Each call resolves `.dkitchen.toml` from the repository the session works in, never from the
directory the harness happened to start in — one harness process serves many repositories.

```toml
repo = "owner/name"

[kitchen]
stations = ["orchestrator", "designer", "verifier", "executor"]

`[permissions]` names a permission preset per station, resolved against the presets the
harness offers when the session is created. A station without an entry opens under the
harness's own default.
section: How a repository configures its kitchen

text:
dsh-dkitchen README · How a repository configures its kitchen：`dkitchen_status` reports what one repository resolved, and `rootSource` says how that
repository was chosen: `argument`, `session`, or `process`. A `process` answer means the
repository was guessed rather than known.
section: How a repository configures its kitchen

text:
dsh-dkitchen README · Retiring a session：`dkitchen_archive` closes out a session the kitchen is done with: the harness hides it from
every surface, it takes no further steps, and dkitchen marks its own row closed. It refuses
while the session still has running work unless `stop` is set, and only the orchestrator may
archive — a station retiring its own replacement mid-run is how a ticket loses the thread of it.

dsh-dkitchen README · Station default models, in Settings：A repository's `.dkitchen.toml` is the right home for a route that belongs to one project, but
every kitchen has to start somewhere. **Settings → Built-in plugins → dkitchen** has one field
per station — orchestrator, designer, verifier, executor — for the model new sessions should
use by default. No JSON, no TOML:

```text
Orchestrator   [ trae/deepseek-v4        ]
Designer       [ trae/deepseek-v4        ]
Verifier       [ trae/claude-sonnet-5    ]
Executor       [ trae/deepseek-v4        ]

dsh-dkitchen README · Station default models, in Settings：Leaving a field empty is not "no model": it hands the decision back to the repository. A
repository that names its own route — or its own `[harness]` defaults — is never overridden.

dsh-dkitchen README · Two deliberate behaviours：**`[approval]` answers by rule, and defers by default.** The harness already asks the user
through its own panel, so a plugin that answered ahead of it would remove that decision.
Naming a tool under `allow` answers it without asking, which is what makes an unattended
kitchen able to run what it was configured for; anything else calls `next()`. With no
`[approval]` section the plugin changes no permission behaviour at all.

dsh-dkitchen README · Two deliberate behaviours：**A background job's settlement arrives as a session notice.** `ctx.jobs` announces it, so a
session that launched work does not have to poll.

dsh-dkitchen README · The page this bundle adds：`client.js` adds a section to this bundle's page in **Plugins**. It reports whether the bundle
is installed and enabled, and says where a repository's configuration lives. It has no
buttons, because nothing here needs running.

dsh-dkitchen README · The page this bundle adds：The station defaults are edited on the Settings page instead, and that form is generated from
the plugin's own configuration schema — `lib/options.js` declares the fields with `volatile()`,
and the harness builds the controls and writes them into the active profile's patch. This
bundle ships no form code of its own.

dsh-dkitchen README · Layout：| Path | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `index.js` | Mounting the plugin: injected services, per-call config resolution, tool registration |
| `lib/` | The tools and the rules behind them |
| `kitchen/` | The station rules the setup skill renders into a repository |
| `skills/setup-dkitchen/` | The setup skill, with a renderer that needs only Node |
| `scripts/market.mjs` | Generating and validating `docs/market/index.json` |
| `docs/plugin.md` | The user-facing guide: installing, every tool, every `.dkitchen.toml` key |
| `tests/` | The suite: `node --test "tests/*.test.mjs"` |

dsh-dkitchen README · Layout：This repository is the bundle: `package.json`, `index.js`, and `lib/` are at the root, which is
why the market index names it without a `path`.

dsh-dkitchen README · Development：```bash
node --test "tests/*.test.mjs"     # the suite; nothing to install first
node scripts/market.mjs index --check
```

On Windows under a restricted shell, `node --test` cannot spawn its per-file child processes;
run `node --test --experimental-test-isolation=none "tests/*.test.mjs"` there instead.

dsh-dkitchen README · Development：Releasing: bump `version` in `package.json`, then push a matching tag such as `v1.0.0`. The
release workflow checks the two agree, runs the suite, regenerates the market index for that
tag's commit, and publishes the GitHub release.

dsh-dkitchen README · Acknowledgements：This plugin is a port, not an original design. The kitchen it implements — stations with fixed
duties, work handed off through GitHub issues as tickets, the status block every comment opens
with, the rules for when a station must stop and ask, and the bell that wakes a session when its
long job exits — comes from **[917Dhj/dkitchen](https://github.com/917Dhj/dkitchen)**, and this
repository follows its functional design closely on purpose: the vocabulary, the refusals, and
the order in which the orchestrator does things are all meant to match. Thank you to
917Dhj/dkitchen for thinking it through and writing it down.

dsh-dkitchen README · Acknowledgements：What differs here is the runtime, not the kitchen. That project drove DeepSeek Harness sessions
from outside the process — a CLI, a broker, an MCP server, a separate profile. This one
registers the same tools inside the harness through `ctx.tools`, so installing the bundle is the
whole installation. The behaviour is meant to stay the same; where this port had to choose, the
choice is recorded in the commit that made it and in the tests.

dsh-dkitchen README · Acknowledgements：The metaphor, and much of the workflow, traces further back: the Michelin-kitchen way of running
agents comes from Lauren Tan ([Poteto](https://github.com/poteto)), and the practice of keeping
tickets on GitHub issues started from the issue tracker setup in
[Matt Pocock's skills](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills).

[English](README.md) | **简体中文**

一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件，把一个仓库变成一间厨房：岗位、票、长任务，以及任务结束时唤醒会话的那只铃。

装上这个 bundle 就等于装完了全部。工具通过 `ctx.tools` 注册在 harness 进程内部，所以没有包要安装，没有单独的 profile 要启动，没有 broker 要运行，也没有 MCP server 要拉起。不需要在旁边维持任何进程。

dsh-dkitchen README · dsh-dkitchen：> **本项目基于 [917Dhj/dkitchen](https://github.com/917Dhj/dkitchen)。** 厨房本身——岗位划分、票的流转、后厨规矩，以及唤醒会话的那只铃——是 [917Dhj/dkitchen](https://github.com/917Dhj/dkitchen) 的设计，本插件是它到 DeepSeek Harness 插件运行时的移植。见[致谢](#致谢)。

dsh-dkitchen README · 安装：**从 Discover 安装。** 在 harness 中打开 **Plugins → Discover**，添加这个索引

```text
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/songmingjun3/dsh-kitchen-plugin/main/docs/market/index.json
```

然后安装 `dkitchen`。索引里钉死的是本仓库的一个确切 commit，所以你装到的就是某个 release 指明的那一份。

**从 release 安装。** 在 [Releases](https://github.com/songmingjun3/dsh-kitchen-plugin/releases) 下载某个 tag 的源码包，解压后把 **Plugins → install bundle** 指向这个目录。

dsh-dkitchen README · 安装：两种方式最终都一样：harness 会把 `cordis.patch.yml` 组合进 profile 并加载 `index.js`。如果 harness 没有自动加载，重启一次。首次启动时，bundle 还会把初始化 skill 装进机器级的 skill 目录，所以每个项目里都能用 `/setup-dkitchen`。

如果 bundle 注册某个工具失败，它是**静默**的——进程照常运行，只是那个工具不见了。在 `cordis.patch.yml` 里把 `debug` 设为 `true`，就能让每次注册都输出到 stderr。

dsh-dkitchen README · 它给会话带来什么：| 分组 | 工具 |
| --- | --- |
| 会话 | `dkitchen_new_session`、`dkitchen_send`、`dkitchen_read`、`dkitchen_info`、`dkitchen_rename`、`dkitchen_list_sessions`、`dkitchen_board`、`dkitchen_session_status`、`dkitchen_archive` |
| 长任务 | `dkitchen_launch`、`dkitchen_logs`、`dkitchen_stop`、`dkitchen_run_status` |
| 票 | `dkitchen_relay`、`dkitchen_merge`、`dkitchen_log`、`dkitchen_executor_status` |
| 监视 | `dkitchen_watch`、`dkitchen_watch_state` |
| 配置 | `dkitchen_config`、`dkitchen_check_refs`、`dkitchen_status` |
dsh-dkitchen README · 它给会话带来什么：票相关的工具需要 `gh` CLI。没有安装时它们会直接说明，其余工具照常工作。

dsh-dkitchen README · 仓库如何配置自己的厨房：每次调用都从**会话所在仓库**解析 `.dkitchen.toml`，而不是从 harness 碰巧启动的那个目录——一个 harness 进程服务多个仓库。

```toml
repo = "owner/name"

[kitchen]
stations = ["orchestrator", "designer", "verifier", "executor"]

`[permissions]` 给每个岗位指定一个权限预设，创建会话时对着 harness 提供的预设解析。没有列出的岗位用 harness 自己的默认预设。

`dkitchen_status` 报告某个仓库解析出了什么，其中 `rootSource` 说明仓库是怎么确定的：`argument`、`session` 或 `process`。`process` 意味着仓库是猜出来的，而不是已知的。
section: 仓库如何配置自己的厨房

text: dsh-dkitchen README · 关闭一个已经结束的会话：`dkitchen_archive` 用来收尾厨房不再需要的会话：harness 会把它从所有界面隐藏、它不再有任何动作，dkitchen 也把自己的记录标为已关闭。会话还有任务在跑时会拒绝，除非传 `stop`；而且只有总编排可以归档——某个岗位在运行中把接替自己的会话关掉，正是票上那条线断掉的开始。
section: 关闭一个已经结束的会话

text:
dsh-dkitchen README · 在设置里改岗位的默认模型：单个模型的归属放在仓库自己的 `.dkitchen.toml` 里最合适，但每间厨房总要有个起点。打开 **Settings → Built-in plugins → dkitchen**，每个岗位一个输入框——总编排、总设计、核查、执行者——填新建会话默认用哪个模型。不用改 JSON，也不用改 TOML：

```text
总编排   [ trae/deepseek-v4        ]
总设计   [ trae/deepseek-v4        ]
核查     [ trae/claude-sonnet-5    ]
执行者   [ trae/deepseek-v4        ]

填 `provider/model`，或者只填模型 id（provider 沿用仓库的设置）。改完之后对**下一个**新建的会话生效——不用重启，因为插件每次调用都会重新读这个值。

优先级从强到弱：
section: 在设置里改岗位的默认模型

text:
dsh-dkitchen README · 在设置里改岗位的默认模型：1. `dkitchen_new_session` 那一次调用里传入的 `provider`/`model`；
2. 仓库 `.dkitchen.toml` 里的 `[models.<station>]`；
3. 这个设置页上的岗位默认值；
4. 仓库文件里的 `[harness] default_provider`/`default_model`。

留空不等于"没有模型"，而是把决定权交回仓库。凡是自己写了路由（或写了自己的 `[harness]` 默认值）的仓库，永远不会被这里覆盖。
section: 在设置里改岗位的默认模型

text:
dsh-dkitchen README · 两个刻意的行为：**`[approval]` 按规则作答，默认一律交回。** harness 本来就会用自己的面板询问用户，插件如果抢在前面作答，就把这个决定权拿掉了。在 `allow` 里列出的工具会被直接放行，这正是无人值守的厨房能跑它被配置去跑的事情的原因；其余的一律调用 `next()` 交回面板。没有 `[approval]` 段时，插件完全不改变任何权限行为。

**后台任务的结束以会话通知的形式送达。** 由 `ctx.jobs` 宣告，所以发起任务的会话不需要轮询。

dsh-dkitchen README · 这个 bundle 增加的页面：`client.js` 会在 **Plugins** 中本 bundle 的页面上加一段内容，报告 bundle 是否已安装、是否启用，以及仓库的配置文件在哪里。没有按钮，因为这里没有任何东西需要运行。

岗位默认模型在 **Settings** 页里改，那个表单是 harness 根据插件自己的配置声明生成的——`lib/options.js` 用 `volatile()` 声明字段，harness 负责搭出控件并写进当前 profile 的 patch。本 bundle 不带任何表单代码。
section: 这个 bundle 增加的页面

text:
dsh-dkitchen README · 目录结构：| 路径 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `index.js` | 挂载插件：注入的服务、按每次调用解析配置、注册工具 |
| `lib/` | 工具，以及工具背后的规则 |
| `lib/options.js` | 插件的配置声明：Settings 里那份岗位默认模型表单就来自这里 |
| `kitchen/` | 初始化 skill 渲染进目标仓库的岗位规则 |
| `skills/setup-dkitchen/` | 初始化 skill，附一个只依赖 Node 的渲染器 |
| `scripts/market.mjs` | 生成并校验 `docs/market/index.json` |
| `docs/plugin.md` | 用户指南：安装、每个工具、每个 `.dkitchen.toml` 配置项 |
| `tests/` | 测试套件：`node --test "tests/*.test.mjs"` |
dsh-dkitchen README · 目录结构：本仓库**就是**这个 bundle：`package.json`、`index.js`、`lib/` 都在根目录，这也是 market 索引里不写 `path` 的原因。

dsh-dkitchen README · 开发：```bash
node --test "tests/*.test.mjs"     # 测试套件，无需先安装任何依赖
node scripts/market.mjs index --check
```

在受限 shell 下的 Windows 上，`node --test` 无法为每个测试文件派生子进程；这种情况下改用 `node --test --experimental-test-isolation=none "tests/*.test.mjs"`。

发布流程：把 `package.json` 里的 `version` 改好，然后推一个与之匹配的 tag（例如 `v1.0.0`）。release workflow 会校验两者一致、跑测试、为该 tag 的 commit 重新生成 market 索引，并发布 GitHub release。

dsh-dkitchen README · 致谢：这个插件是移植，不是原创设计。它实现的这间厨房——职责固定的岗位、用 GitHub issue 当票来交接工作、每条留言开头固定的状态块、什么时候必须停下发问的规矩，以及长任务退出时唤醒会话的那只铃——都来自 **[917Dhj/dkitchen](https://github.com/917Dhj/dkitchen)**。本仓库**刻意**紧贴它的功能设计：术语、拒绝的条件、以及总编排执行动作的顺序，都力求与之一致。感谢 917Dhj/dkitchen 把这件事想清楚并写了下来。

不同的地方在运行时，不在厨房。那个项目在进程**外部**驱动 DeepSeek Harness 会话——一个命令行工具、一个 broker、一个 MCP server、一个独立的 profile。本项目把同一批工具通过 `ctx.tools` 注册在 harness **内部**，所以装上 bundle 就装完了。行为上力求保持一致；凡是移植时不得不做选择的地方，选择都记录在做出该选择的那次提交和对应的测试里。

dsh-dkitchen README · 致谢：再往前追溯，这个比喻和这套工作流的很多部分还有更早的来源：米其林后厨这个比喻来自 Lauren Tan（[Poteto](https://github.com/poteto)），用 GitHub issue 管票的做法最初改自 [Matt Pocock 的 skills](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills) 里的 issue tracker 配置。
